shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- useTheme.d.ts ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && printf '\\n--- useThemeValue.d.ts ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export.*Theme|Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40 && printf '\\n--- package exports ---\\n' && rg -n '\"./build/esm\"' -A 4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -20 && printf '\\n--- esm index ---\\n' && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- components index ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -120"
